summary.description: What the change does and your overall judgment of it, in one or two short plain sentences.

findings.description: Every problem you found, one per finding. Empty when you found none.

path.description: The repository-relative path of the file the finding is in.

line.description: The 1-based line in the reviewed commit's version of the file, when the finding has one.

severity.description: blocking when the change must not merge until this is fixed; advisory otherwise. A blocking quality, design or conventions finding must cite a rule.

category.description: The dimension the finding belongs to.

rule.description: The rule the finding applies: a principle id, or a repository convention file with a verbatim quote from it.

principle.description: A principle id shown in the engineering principles, such as design.1.

file.description: The repository-relative path of the convention file the quote is from, such as CLAUDE.md.

quote.description: The rule, quoted verbatim from that file.

body.description: What is wrong and what would fix it, in one short plain line without Markdown.

dimensions.description: Your answer for every dimension of the review.

criteria.description: Your answer for every listed acceptance criterion, by its id. Empty when none are listed.

id.description: The criterion's id as listed, such as AC1.

status.description: met when the change satisfies the criterion; unmet when it does not; not_verifiable when the diff and checkout cannot show either.

evidence.description: Where the change meets or misses the criterion (a file or test), or why it cannot be verified, in one short plain line.

tests.description: Whether the change's tests are adequate.

assessment.description: adequate when tests cover the changed behaviour; missing when changed behaviour is untested; not_needed when the change has no behaviour to test.

reason.description: Why you judged the tests that way, in one short plain line.

coveringTests.description: The repository-relative paths of the test files that cover the change.

status.description: clear when you checked and found nothing; findings when the findings list has at least one finding in this category; not_applicable when the change gives this dimension nothing to judge.

note.description: What you checked for this dimension, in a sentence or two.
